sources.title: zeromodels/regnet-y-008 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: zeromodels/regnet-y-008 Paper: Designing Network Design Spaces (arXiv:2003.13678) · HF Papers RegNet is a family of ConvNets whose per-stage widths and depths follow a simple quantized-linear rule. This is the Y (with Squeeze-and-Excitation) variant: a 3x3 stride-2 stem then four stages of 1x1 -> 3x3 grouped -> [SE] -> 1x1 residual blocks.

sources.title: Efficient Edge AI: RegNet-Y-008 Hits Huawei's Modelers Platform
sources.snippet: The goal here is clear: delivering performance without the bloat. As a member of the RegNet family originally developed by Facebook AI Research, the Y-008 variant targets a very specific computational budget. It is essentially a 'micro' model, likely utilising around 0.08 GFLOPS. This makes it an excellent candidate for edge devices and mobile deployment where power consumption is a critical ...

sources.title: glasses/regnety_008 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: regnety_008 Implementation of RegNet proposed in Designing Network Design Spaces The main idea is to start with a high dimensional search space and iteratively reduce the search space by empirically apply constrains based on the best performing models sampled by the current search space.

sources.title: regnety_008.pycls_in1k | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: What is regnety_008.pycls_in1k? RegNetY-008 is a lightweight convolutional neural network designed for image classification tasks, developed as part of the RegNet family of models. This particular implementation achieves 76.296% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k, making it suitable for resource-constrained applications while maintaining reasonable performance.
